SCRIPT_HEIGHTMAP_DESC: Change the vertical range, preserving elevations or scaling them around zero. The change is one undo step.
SCRIPT_HEIGHTMAP_MODE_TOOLTIP: Range only keeps elevations within the new precision and refuses a range that would clip terrain. Rescale heights multiplies elevations by new maximum / old maximum. Step shortcuts only change the range.
SCRIPT_HEIGHTMAP_MAX_TOOLTIP: The range is -maximum to +maximum. Used by the two custom maximum operations; ignored by the step shortcuts. Only the heightmap is scaled; placed objects keep their authored positions.
SCRIPT_HEIGHTMAP_PRECISION: Step shortcuts set float precision above zero; negative heights have finer steps. Range changes can round elevations. Decimal steps have normal floating-point approximation.
SCRIPT_HEIGHTMAP_INVALID_MODE: Select a valid heightmap rescaling operation.
